rituals.name: Sunlight Exposure
rituals.description: Get 10-15 minutes of direct sunlight within an hour of waking.
rituals.science_reference: Viewing morning sunlight triggers cortisol release and sets the circadian clock.

rituals.name: Box Breathing
rituals.description: Inhale, hold, exhale, and hold for 4 seconds each.
rituals.science_reference: Regulates the autonomic nervous system and lowers morning anxiety.

rituals.description: Drink 500ml of water with a pinch of sea salt.
rituals.science_reference: Rehydrates the brain and organs after 8 hours of sleep-induced dehydration.
